Path 3, costGOALS §10.5

Network Flow Monitor vs eBPF

Two ways to attribute network traffic and cost: run one, not both.

WHAT IT IS

NFM is the EKS Container Network Observability add-on: a node agent reporting top flows plus ENA allowance counters. eBPF tools, like Cilium's Hubble or Adobe's pipeline, read flows in-kernel.

WHAT SETS IT APART

NFM is lowest effort on EKS and exposes allowance-exceeded counters nothing else reports, but it's AWS-only, capped near 5,000 nodes, and blind to host-network pods. eBPF covers on-prem too.

WHERE WE STAND

Decision 8. ⚠️ Confirm the add-on name and pricing before enabling it fleet-wide.

EKS network observability docs; "From Packets to Paychecks" (Adobe), KubeCon NA 2026

DECIDE

Network Flow Monitor vs eBPF: Two ways to attribute network traffic and cost: run one, not both. Where we stand: Decision 8. ⚠️ Confirm the add-on name and pricing before enabling it fleet-wide. Per-namespace egress and retransmits also make a cheap, app-agnostic canary signal. That's our idea, to test.
